'''Johan Haneveer''' is a Star Wars CCG player whose decks were published on [[Trandosite]], [[Rod Latham]]'s UK fan site.<ref name="trandosite">[http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com/ds78.htm Anti-Revolver], [[Trandosite]]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20001215170300/http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com:80/ds78.htm Internet Archive]</ref>
